title: Efficient Agnostic Learning of Univariate Densities Under Local Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.21033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a general framework for non-interactive locally differentially private (LDP) learning of structured univariate distributions that can be approximated by piece-wise polynomials. This gives the first sample-efficient LDP learners for several distribution classes, including mixtures of log-concave distributions, such as Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). These learners also provide agnostic guarantees and are computationally efficient. We also prove a lower bound for learning GMMs under LDP, improving on the standard pure-DP packing lower bounds of Bun et al. [BKSW19]. To obtain our general learning framework, we develop an efficient non-interactive LDP algorithm for synthetic data generation over large domains, which may be of independent interest. We then use it together with a deterministic adaptation of the non-private piecewise polynomial learner of Acharya et al. [ADLS17].

translated_title: 局部差分隐私下单变量密度的高效不可知学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于非交互式局部差分隐私（LDP）学习的通用框架，适用于可由分段多项式逼近的结构化单变量分布。这为若干分布类提供了首个样本高效的LDP学习器，包括对数凹分布的混合分布，例如高斯混合模型（GMMs）。这些学习器还提供不可知保证，并且在计算上是高效的。我们还证明了在LDP下学习GMM的一个下界，改进了Bun等人[BKSW19]的标准纯DP装箱下界。为了构建我们的通用学习框架，我们开发了一种针对大域上合成数据生成的高效非交互式LDP算法，该算法可能具有独立的研究价值。随后，我们将其与Acharya等人[ADLS17]的非私有分段多项式学习器的确定性改编版本结合使用。
tldr: 本文提出了一个非交互式局部差分隐私学习框架，实现了对可被分段多项式逼近的单变量分布（如高斯混合模型）首个样本高效且计算高效的不可知学习，并为此开发了可独立使用的大域LDP合成数据生成算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general non-interactive locally differentially private learning framework, achieving the first sample-efficient and computationally efficient agnostic LDP learners for univariate distributions approximable by piecewise polynomials (such as GMMs), supported by an efficient LDP synthetic data generation algorithm for large domains.
